default.change_line: Changed 24 August 2026, 11:02 UTC from a signed-in session on macOS.

changes.detail: Applies to every sign-in on the web and in the mobile apps.
You were not signed out anywhere. Sessions already open stay valid until they expire.

expectations.heading: We will ask for
expectations.text: Your password, then the six-digit code your authenticator app is showing at that moment.

expectations.heading: We will never ask for
expectations.text: A code over the phone, by email or in a chat window. Anyone who does is not us.

turned-off.state_detail: — a password on its own is now enough to sign in to this account.
turned-off.body: The second step has been removed from this account. From your next sign-in, your password is the only thing standing between anyone and your data.
turned-off.change_line: Changed 24 August 2026, 18:40 UTC from a signed-in session on macOS.

changes.detail: No code will be requested at sign-in, on any device.
Pixel 9 is no longer registered against this account.
The ten codes issued in August will no longer work. New ones are generated if you turn the control back on.

expectations.heading: We will ask for
expectations.text: Your password alone, until you turn two-step verification back on.

expectations.heading: We will never ask for
expectations.text: Your password over the phone, by email or in a chat window. Anyone who does is not us.

turned-off.recovery_text: There are no recovery codes on this account while the second step is off. Turning it back on issues a fresh set.
turned-off.undo_text: You can turn two-step verification back on in security settings. It takes about a minute and needs the camera on your phone.

sparse.recovery_text: Your recovery codes were shown once during setup and are not retrievable from here. If you did not save them, turn the control off and on again to be issued a new set.
